Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04124
⌈If the configuration parameter DemDebounceCounterStorage is set to True, the
Dem module shall store the current value of the internal debounce counter non-
volatile (refer to [SWS_Dem_00341]).⌋
Note: DemDebounceCounterStorage is not supported for time based debouncing.
[SWS_Dem_00675]
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04124
⌈If the configuration parameter DemDebounceCounterStorage is set to True, the
Dem module shall re-store the current value of the internal debounce counter dur-
ing each startup (latest in Dem_Init).⌋
Note: BSW events using non-volatile storage of the internal debounce counter can-
not be reported before Dem_Init, because the value needs first to be restored.
[SWS_Dem_00676]
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04124
⌈If development error detection is enabled and Dem_SetEventStatus or Dem_Re-
setEventDebounceStatus is called before Dem_Init or after Dem_Shutdown for
events which have DemDebounceCounterStorage set to True, the Dem module shall
set the error code DEM_E_WRONG_CONDITION.⌋
